svg.text: Figure 22-2. Offline Aggregation Pipeline, Trie Snapshot Rollout, and Edge Query Path.

g.text: Control & Offline Build Plane (Aggregation, Filtering & Snapshot Rollout)
Batch pipeline decouples write-heavy counting from read-only edge serving nodes
Online Data Plane (Edge Query Path: Read-Only, < 20 ms p99)
Debounced keystrokes hit CDN cache first, then prefix-sharded in-memory trie replicas
Discards late replies when response_seq < latest_seq
Loads v108 beside v107, flips read pointer lock-free

svg.text: Solid wires trace the < 20 ms synchronous keystroke lookup path (steps 1-3); dashed
wires mark the offline decay/build pipeline (4-5) and lock-free snapshot rollout (6).
Client-side debouncing and sequence numbers prevent stale network
responses from overwriting newer keystrokes in the search box.
